latHint: Think Sunday dinner, with the oven on for hours.
pivHint: To BASTE in sewing is to stitch loosely so fabric stays put for a while. In the kitchen, you BASTE a turkey with its own juices as it cooks into a golden ______.
winText: Golden brown. BASTE was the pivot - loose stitches to juices spooned over a ROAST.
lossText: ROAST - meat cooked slowly in an oven. BASTE was the pivot: to BASTE in sewing is to stitch loosely, but to BASTE in cooking is to spoon juices over meat as it cooks into a ROAST.
